observation.command: ps -o user,pid,ppid,etime,cmd -C qisutu-daemon.pl 2>/dev/null || ps aux | grep qisutu-daemon.pl | grep -v grep; echo '---customer portal---'; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "customer login: %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost/qisutu/index.pl?Step=Login" ; curl -s "http://localhost/qisutu/install.pl" | grep -oiE '(bereits installiert|Installationsassistent)[^<]{0,40}' | head -2; echo '---lock re-run guard---'; cd /opt/qisutu && timeout 10 bash -c 'QISUTU_INSTALL_LANGUAGE=de ./install.sh 2>&1' | tail -5; echo "install.sh re-run exit: $?"
